column1: # Seed ledger: the deterministic operation streams this suite runs.
# One row per stream the container's run exercises.  The digest column records
# what a passing run produced when the row was written; a change of digest means
# the stream's deterministic replay changed and must be explained in the round's
# run record, never silently accepted.  Operations are the ordered stream's
# length; the profile names the pool geometry the stream ran under.

column5: first seeded stream, mixed legal and misuse operators
